_comment: CORS policy for the hamza-media R2 bucket. Required for presigned browser uploads (MEDIA_DIRECT_UPLOAD_ENABLED=true). Apply with: npx wrangler r2 bucket cors put hamza-media --file hamza-backend/r2-cors.json   (or paste into the Cloudflare dashboard: R2 > hamza-media > Settings > CORS Policy). Origin must be the ADMIN app origin, not the API. Keep AllowedHeaders in sync with src/lib/mediaClient.js uploadMedia() -- the preflight will fail if Cache-Control is missing, and the PUT is rejected unless it carries the signed Cache-Control header.
